spans.text: Under Judge's leadership, Fe56 storms into the main hall in the Eastern Tower through the front doors, which have already been blown off.
Having been cleared by Squad Daybreak, the hall is silent save for the faint sound of Squad Daybreak's gunfire coming from upstairs.
Destroyer, Alchemist, search the hall for any remaining supplies and make sure to eliminate any Nytos who managed to survive.
The prayer room isn't very large. Destroyer and Alchemist search it for a few minutes before coming back.
Meh, Daybreak didn't leave much for us to do.
There isn't anything interesting left here besides that headless statue.
That sword the statue is holding is still covered in blood.
My guess is someone fell down several days ago and got impaled on it.
What a romantic way to die.
Alright, we've finished sweeping the hall.
Dreamer, search the other passages. We're going to take everything of value from the Eastern Tower.
Right. Looks like there are two routes we can take.
Namely, the eastern and western staircases, which lead to different areas. Your choice.
The eastern staircase is littered with Nyto corpses. Looks like Squad Daybreak came this way.
The western staircase is dark. Flashlights or night-vision gear will be needed if we go this way.
